title: Resolucao dinamica de modelos por backend (codex + claude): descobrir/validar slugs em vez de pinar
description: PROBLEMA: hoje pinamos slugs de modelo concretos na config (project.toml [models], e para codex [models.codex].<phase>). Slug concreto apodrece: gpt-5.3-codex foi aposentado pela OpenAI e virou HTTP 400 'not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account', MAL-DIAGNOSTICADO como wall de entitlement de conta bloqueando CAM-54 (journal SESSION-CAM396/CAM-397 2026-07-22). Causa real: slug morto na config, nao entitlement. Conta ChatGPT Plus usa codex normalmente com slugs atuais (validado ao vivo: gpt-5.6-sol/gpt-5.5/codex-auto-review respondem via `codex exec`; gpt-5.3-codex/gpt-5.1-codex/gpt-5/o3 todos 400). OBJETIVO: camada de resolucao/validacao de modelo que descobre a lista de slugs disponiveis por backend e valida ou auto-resolve o modelo configurado antes do dispatch. CODEX: ler ~/.codex/models_cache.json (mantido pelo codex; campos slug/display_name/visibility/supported_in_api/priority). Politica deterministica: filtrar visibility=='list' && supported_in_api==true, ordenar por priority asc, pegar topo (hoje gpt-5.6-sol, priority 1). Slug pinado vira override opcional; fallback pro pinado se parse falhar. FRAGILIDADE (fator de custo, nao rebaixa a recomendacao): models_cache.json e cache interno nao-documentado do codex, schema pode mudar entre versoes, nao existe `codex models` publico (codex-cli 0.144.6). Precisa fallback + parse resiliente. CLAUDE: sem apodrecimento hoje (opus/sonnet sao aliases publicos estaveis resolvidos server-side), mas o operador quer descoberta/validacao consistente pros dois backends. FORK PRA GRILLING/SPEC: como enumerar modelos claude na CLI de subscription (sem API key, projeto subscription-only)? existe `claude models`? No minimo validar/fail-closed com aviso se o modelo configurado nao resolver, em vez de 400 silencioso. TOUCH POINTS: readNestedBackendModel (sem claude-alias guard: sem [models.codex].<phase> o codex recebe alias claude flat tipo 'opus'), readPhaseModel, src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts, camada de config. TIPO feat. Precisa grilling/spec antes de build (fork claude-enumeration + fragilidade cache interno). Relacionado CAM-54. Interino: CAM-54 fecha com gpt-5.6-sol pinado.

spec.scope: Add a dynamic model-resolution and validation layer that runs before every LLM dispatch. Codex backend: resolve the model from ~/.codex/models_cache.json (filter visibility==list AND supported_in_api==true, sort priority ascending, pick top) when no valid [models.codex].<phase> pin is set; honor a configured pin as an optional override taking precedence over cache resolution; fail closed with an actionable error when the cache is missing/unreadable/schema-incompatible AND no valid pin exists, instead of leaking a flat claude alias into `codex exec -m`. Claude backend: a deterministic typo-guard that fails closed with a warning when the configured model is neither a known alias (default, best, fable, opus, sonnet, haiku, opusplan, sonnet[1m], opus[1m]) nor a claude-* full-name. Integrate coherently with the existing codexAuthPreflight/isClaudeAliasModel choke point rather than adding a duplicate parallel guard. OUT OF SCOPE: any live probing of claude models (impossible under subscription-only: no `claude models` command, /model is interactive-picker-only, subscription OAuth cannot hit /v1/models), any API-key-based enumeration, and the pre-existing orchestrator-codex dispatch gap (buildOrchestratorPaneCommand hardcodes claude at run.ts:275).
acceptanceCriteria: For the codex backend, when `[models.codex].<phase>` has no valid pin, the model dispatched to `codex exec -m` is auto-resolved from `~/.codex/models_cache.json`: entries filtered to visibility==list and supported_in_api==true, sorted by priority ascending, top slug chosen (gpt-5.6-sol at priority 1 with the current cache); it never falls through to a flat claude alias. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
A concrete slug configured in `[models.codex].<phase>` is honored verbatim as an override and takes precedence over cache auto-resolution. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

When the codex cache is missing, unreadable, or schema-incompatible AND no valid `[models.codex].<phase>` pin exists, every codex dispatch fails closed before argv-build with an actionable error naming the cache path and the pin remedy; no codex exec process is spawned with an unresolved or claude-alias model. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

For the claude backend, a configured model that is neither a known alias (default, best, fable, opus, sonnet, haiku, opusplan, sonnet[1m], opus[1m]) nor a claude-* full-name causes the dispatch to fail closed with a warning naming the offending value; any valid alias or claude-* full-name proceeds unchanged. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The codex models-cache reader is a pure function behind an injectable DI seam mirroring codexAuthCheck in src/supervisor/codex-auth.ts, unit-tested with fakes for the list/supported/priority filter and the fail-closed empty/malformed paths, with the real default reader covered by a scratch-tmpdir test that does not monkeypatch os.homedir(). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The new resolution/validation layer runs before every LLM spawn at all five dispatch sites (orchestrator, implementer, planner, auditor, reviewer), following the existing codexAuthPreflight DI and chdir test precedent. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
The model-config resolution test suite passes, including the extended backend-aware resolution and claude typo-guard cases. [oracle: bun test test/config/models.test.ts]
The full quality spine passes. [oracle: bun run check:all]
gotchas: The premise that readNestedBackendModel has no claude-alias guard is only half true: a partial guard already exists downstream at codexAuthPreflight + isClaudeAliasModel (src/supervisor/codex-auth.ts:77,127) but its regex /\b(opus|sonnet|haiku)\b/i misses default/fable/opusplan/sonnet[1m]/opus[1m]. Extend or subsume this choke point; do not add a duplicate parallel guard.

The single dispatch choke pattern is readPhaseBackend -> readPhaseModel -> codexAuthPreflight -> selectAdapter(backend).buildSpawnArgv. codexAuthPreflight runs immediately before argv-build at all 5 sites: run.ts:495, loop.ts:1238, plan-runner.ts:633 and :690, review.ts:443. Plug the resolution/validation layer at this choke, not scattered across adapters.

readPhaseModel fallback chain (src/config/models.ts:158-178): [models.<backend>].<phase> (skipped when backend is undefined or claude) -> flat [models].<phase> -> DEFAULTS[phase]. The origin bug is a codex backend with no [models.codex].<phase> falling to the flat claude alias; test/config/models.test.ts:265-291 currently asserts that fall-through as intentional, so that test must be updated in lockstep.

No codex models_cache reader exists anywhere (grep models_cache = 0 hits in src and test). The only ~/.codex/* code today is codexAuthCheck reading ~/.codex/auth.json via existsSync (src/supervisor/codex-auth.ts:60). Mirror its DI-seam idiom: an injectable reader fn for fakes plus a separate scratch-tmpdir test of the real reader; never monkeypatch os.homedir().

models_cache.json is an undocumented internal codex cache; schema is { models: [ { slug, display_name, visibility, supported_in_api, priority, ... } ] } and codex-cli 0.144.6 has no public `codex models`. Parse resiliently and fall back to the pin (or fail closed) on any schema drift. This fragility is a cost factor, not a reason to weaken fail-closed.

The claude alias allowlist to reuse is MODEL_OPTIONS in src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx:98-107 (8 entries), but it lives in a .tsx and does NOT include the claude-* full-name shape; the full-name half needs a new regex. Consider relocating the canonical allowlist to a non-UI module so both the picker and the guard share one source.

loop.ts and plan-runner.ts have NO configPath test seam (only review.ts does, via MakeReviewDispatchOptions.configPath from CAM-405). Their tests chdir into a tmpdir with a staged scripts/cam/project.toml (loop.test.ts withCodexBackendCwd helper). Follow that precedent; do not add a configPath seam to loop/plan-runner unless a story specifically needs it.

ship is deterministic/zero-LLM (ADR-0009) with no dispatch site, so there is no 6th call site. The orchestrator resolves+gates codex but buildOrchestratorPaneCommand hardcodes claude (run.ts:275); leave that pre-existing gap out of scope.
domainTerms: model resolution: turning a configured phase+backend into the concrete model slug passed to the spawned LLM process (codex exec -m / claude --model), including cache auto-resolution for codex.
typo-guard: a deterministic fail-closed validation that a configured claude model is a known alias or a claude-* full-name, catching project.toml misconfiguration before dispatch.
models_cache.json: codex's undocumented internal cache at ~/.codex/models_cache.json listing available model slugs with visibility/supported_in_api/priority fields.
dispatch choke point: codexAuthPreflight, the pre-argv-build fail-closed gate run at all five LLM dispatch sites.
